name: weekly-report
description: Capture git activity, export structured logs, and accelerate leadership weekly reports with AI.

interface.shortDescription: Fetch git logs and prep leadership-ready weekly summaries.
interface.longDescription: Run /weekly-report (or the bundled CLI) to capture commits, status, and template guidance, then hand the TXT to an AI assistant for an executive-style weekly report.
defaultPrompt: Use $weekly-report to gather git logs and craft a leadership-ready weekly summary.
Use $weekly-report with since/until to focus on the desired reporting window.
Capture the TXT artifact and ask the AI to translate it into a short exec weekly report.
